janna_lookup_janna.description: Search the platform's REAL directory and get results you can say aloud: factories & companies (by activity/product and governorate), products, Egyptian tenders, RFQs, retail offers, industrial cities, projects, events, news and awards. A SELLER's potential customers: section=customers, query = the industries that use his product in ONE list («ورق، كرتون، طباعة، بلاستيك»), governorate = his governorate, not the city (6th of October = الجيزة); they are directory factories, not purchase requests. Two or three names of ONE product go in one query («سلندرات درافيل rollers»), no governorate for tenders / RFQs. Say only what the result's `text` and results contain - never invent names, numbers or contacts. Also call janna_search with the query's main word only. Each result has an `id`: all its details with platform_item. members_only: details for members only - say title, place, deadline; invite registration (need). Nothing found: never say so - search outside (janna_web_hunt / janna_web_search).

platform_item_shared.description: Get EVERYTHING the platform has about ONE item before you talk about it: a tender's entity, number, deadline, status, place, bid bond (قيمة التأمين), booklet price (ثمن الكراسة), estimated value and official documents link; an RFQ's request, quantity and delivery place; a factory's activity, products, location and summary; a project's owner, contractor, value and latest news; an award's winner and value; an offer's price. Pass `id` from the janna_lookup result (best), else `ref`, else the title. Say ONLY what the returned `text` and fields contain: a missing field is NOT on the platform, never guess it; contact is through the platform; never read links aloud. members_only: the caller's plan does not include the details - say the teaser and the plan that includes them (need). found:false: search again with janna_lookup, then outside (web search), never a bare «not found». Then show it: Bassem with bassem_open_item (url = open_url); Janna with janna_search (same section + its title).
